start: A gym member: phone that had Google Drive backup linked in an older version, not signed in to a MettleUp account, on the Workout tab

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: Card: 'Backups now go to your MettleUp account. Sign in to keep your workouts safe.'
must_not: Two notice cards drawn at the same time
The old 'last backed up to Google Drive' card

steps.action: Tap 'Sign in'
user_sees: Settings page Backup and restore opens
The card is gone from the Workout tab
must_not: The Backup page opening twice
A sign-in starting without the member choosing it on the Backup page

steps.action: Go back to the Workout tab
must_not: The card coming back on this phone, even if the member did not sign in

start: A gym member: phone that never linked Google Drive, or is already signed in to a MettleUp account, or runs a build that cannot sign in

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: No backup card; the tab looks as usual
must_not: The card shown to a signed-in member (nothing for them to do)
A 'Sign in' link that leads to a page with no sign-in

steps.action: Open the Workout tab when the phone cannot read its saved marks
must_not: An error message or a blank gap where the card would be
A card that cannot be closed

start: A gym member: phone with Google Drive linked from an older version, not signed in, card showing

steps.action: Tap 'Got it'
must_not: The card staying until the next visit
Any backup or sign-in starting

steps.action: Close the app fully and open the Workout tab again
must_not: The card shown a second time on this phone

steps.action: Sign in on Settings, Backup and restore, then sign out again
user_sees: No backup card on the Workout tab
must_not: The one-off card returning after a sign-out

steps.action: Open the Workout tab while another notice card has the slot
must_not: This card drawn under or over the other notice

start: A gym member: phone with Google Drive linked from an older version, not signed in, card showing

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: It says backups now go to the MettleUp account; it does not say a Drive backup is still being made
must_not: Words that suggest workouts are already safe when no account is signed in

steps.action: Tap 'Got it' and keep using the app without signing in
must_not: Any workout sent to Google Drive
Any workout sent to a MettleUp account the member did not sign in to
